class Author

        def __new__(cls) -> Author.Core
    class Extension(Author)

    class Provider(Author)
        def __new__(cls) -> Author.Provider
    class Tools(Author)
        def __new__(cls) -> Author.Tools
class Body

class Client(AsyncIterator[Event], Protocol)
    async def abort(self, cursor: int) -> None
    async def answer(self, question: int, value: object) -> None
    async def children(self, id: int) -> list[int]

    async def commands(self) -> tuple[Form, ...]
    async def complete(self, cursor: int, named: str, prefix: str) -> list[str]

    async def configure(
        self,
        cursor: int,
        extension: str,
        values: Mapping[str, object],
        *,
        save: bool = False,
    ) -> None
    async def go_to(self, cursor: int, to: int) -> None
    id: str
    async def input(self, cursor: int, text: str) -> int
    async def node(self, id: int) -> Node
    async def nodes(self, start: int, limit: int) -> list[Node]
    async def open(self, at: int) -> int
    async def options(self, cursor: int, extension: str) -> Form
    async def parse_line(self, cursor: int, line: str) -> Parsed
    async def remove_item(self, cursor: int, item: int) -> None
    async def remove_label(self, label: str) -> None
    async def reopen(self, cursor: int) -> int
    async def run(self, cursor: int, command: str, args: Mapping[str, object]) -> str | None
    async def send(self, cursor: int, text: str) -> int

== machine: The step machine
class Answer
    class CallDone(Answer)
        def __new__(cls, call: str, outcome: Outcome, by: Author) -> Answer.CallDone
        property by: Author
        property call: str
        property outcome: Outcome
    class HookFailed(Answer)
        def __new__(cls, error: str) -> Answer.HookFailed
        property error: str
    class Hooks(Answer)
        def __new__(cls, stop: str | None = None, draft: Draft | None = None) -> Answer.Hooks
        property draft: Draft | None
        property stop: str | None
    class Sampled(Answer)
        def __new__(cls, parts: Sequence[Part], end: SampleEnd) -> Answer.Sampled
        property end: SampleEnd
        property parts: list[Part]
class Ending
    class Aborted(Ending)
        def __new__(cls) -> Ending.Aborted
    class Done(Ending)
        def __new__(cls) -> Ending.Done
    class Failed(Ending)
        def __new__(cls, error: str) -> Ending.Failed
        property error: str
    class Halted(Ending)
        def __new__(cls, reason: str) -> Ending.Halted
        property reason: str
class Hook
    PostReply: ClassVar[Hook]
    PostResult: ClassVar[Hook]
    PostStep: ClassVar[Hook]
    PreInput: ClassVar[Hook]
    PreReply: ClassVar[Hook]
    PreSample: ClassVar[Hook]
    PreStep: ClassVar[Hook]
    property name: str
class Job
    class Hooks(Job)
        def __new__(
            cls,
            point: Hook,
            draft: Draft | None,
            node: int | None,
            ending: Ending | None,
        ) -> Job.Hooks
        property draft: Draft | None
        property ending: Ending | None
        property node: int | None
        property point: Hook
    class Pending(Job)
        def __new__(cls) -> Job.Pending
    class Rest(Job)
        def __new__(cls) -> Job.Rest
    class RunCalls(Job)
        def __new__(cls, node: int, calls: Sequence[RunCall]) -> Job.RunCalls
        property calls: list[RunCall]
        property node: int
    class Sample(Job)
        def __new__(cls) -> Job.Sample
class Next
    RunTools: ClassVar[Next]
    Sample: ClassVar[Next]
    Wait: ClassVar[Next]
class RunCall
    property args_raw: str
    property id: str
    property tool: str
class SampleEnd
    class Cancelled(SampleEnd)
        def __new__(cls) -> SampleEnd.Cancelled
    class Failed(SampleEnd)
        def __new__(cls, error: str, meta: str | None = None) -> SampleEnd.Failed
        property error: str
        property meta: str | None
    class Finished(SampleEnd)
        def __new__(
            cls,
            stop: Stop,
            reason: str | None = None,
            meta: str | None = None,
        ) -> SampleEnd.Finished
        property meta: str | None
        property reason: str | None
        property stop: Stop
class Session
    def abort(self, cursor: int) -> bool
    def add_item(self, to: int, data: ItemData) -> int
    def answer(self, cursor: int, answer: Answer, now: int) -> None
    def append(self, parent: int, body: Body, by: Author, now: int) -> int
    def append_root(self, config: Config, by: Author, now: int) -> int
    def close(self) -> None
    def close_cursor(self, cursor: int) -> None
    def closed(self) -> list[tuple[int, int]]
    @staticmethod
    def create(
        config: Config,
        system: str,
        now: int,
        directory: str | PathLike[str] | None = None,
    ) -> Session
    def cursor(self, cursor: int) -> CursorState
    def cursors(self) -> list[int]
    def fork(self, node: int, now: int, directory: str | PathLike[str] | None = None) -> Session
    def go_to(self, cursor: int, to: int, client: str, now: int) -> bool
    def hook_move(self, cursor: int, to: int, by: Author, now: int) -> None
    def hook_set_auto(self, cursor: int, on: bool) -> None
    def hook_write(self, cursor: int, body: Body, delivers: Sequence[int], by: Author, now: int) -> int
    def input(self, cursor: int, by: Author, text: str) -> int
    def label(self, label: str) -> int
    def labels(self) -> list[tuple[str, int]]
    @staticmethod
    def load(directory: str | PathLike[str]) -> Session
    def next_job(self, cursor: int) -> Job
    def open(self, at: int, by: Author, now: int) -> int
    @staticmethod
    def read(directory: str | PathLike[str]) -> Session
    def remove_item(self, id: int) -> None
    def remove_label(self, label: str) -> None
    def set_auto(self, cursor: int, on: bool) -> None
    def set_label(self, label: str, cursor: int) -> None
    def step(self, cursor: int) -> None
    def take_notices(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]
    property tree: Tree

== config: Configuration and context
Ask = Callable[[str], bool]
class ConfigError(ValueError)
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ConfigProblem
    column: int | None = None
    line: int | None = None
    message: str
    path: str = ''
    severity: Severity
    source: str | None = None
class ContextFileError(ConfigError)
class DotenvError(ValueError)
class ExtensionLoadError(ImportError)
    def __init__(self, message: str, sources: Sequence['ExtensionSource'] = ()) -> None
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExtensionSource
    commands: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    detail: str | None = None
    extensions: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    key: str
    kind: SourceKind
    origin: str
    state: SourceState
    tools: tuple[str, ...] = ()
Layer = Path | LayerText
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LayerText
    source: str
    text: str
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LoadedConfig
    catalog: ModelCatalog
    environ: Mapping[str, str]
    home: Path
    project: Trusted | None
    user: UserConfig
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelCatalog
    default_model: str | None
    def explain(self, qualified: str) -> tuple[Origin, ...]
    extensions: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, object]] = field(default_factory=lambda: {})
    def find(self, name: str) -> tuple[str, ...]
    load: Mapping[str, bool] = field(default_factory=lambda: {})
    load_sources: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=lambda: {})
    models: Mapping[str, ResolvedModel]
    def names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]
    def resolve(self, qualified: str) -> ModelConfig
    system_prompt: str | None = None
    system_prompt_source: str | None = None
    tui: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=lambda: {})
    warnings: tuple[ConfigProblem, ...]
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelConfig
    def api_key(self, environ: Mapping[str, str]) -> str | None
    api_key_env: str | None = None
    base_url: str | None = None
    context_window: int | None = None
    literal_api_key: str | None = field(default=None, repr=False)
    max_tokens: int | None = None
    model: str
    options: Mapping[str, object] = field(default_factory=lambda: {})
    price: Price | None = None
    provider: str = 'openai'
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Origin

    source: str

    ) -> ModelCatalog

    def __init__(self, root: Path, message: str, layer: LayerText | None) -> None
